territorial_scope.description: Applies across the Argentine territory; benefits for projects located in a jurisdiction require its express and full adhesion, and jurisdictions that do not adhere block benefits there.

evidence.quote: El Súper RIGI será de aplicación en todo el territorio de la República Argentina.

summary.short: Bill creating the Súper RIGI investment-incentive regime for approved projects of at least US$1,000 million in new industries. Approved project vehicles get reduced income tax, customs, VAT, FX and social-security benefits, with 30-year stability. Applies nationally; provincial benefits require adhesion. Enters into force the day after publication.
summary.long: Bill (Expte. 5-P.E.-2026, Orden del Día 149, majority committee report of 17 June 2026) creating the Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones en Nuevas Industrias (Súper RIGI). Projects dedicated exclusively to new economic activities may join through Vehículos de Proyecto Único (VPU) if they commit at least US$1,000 million in qualifying assets, with 20% within the first two years (Arts. 4, 6, 12). The Autoridad de Aplicación approves or rejects applications within 90 business days (Art. 18). Approved VPU receive a 15% income tax rate, accelerated depreciation, customs and export-duty exemptions, VAT settlement through tax credit certificates, a 10% employer contribution rate for new employment relations, and FX-market relief. Dividends paid to individuals are taxed at 7%, falling to 3.5% after four years (Arts. 34–71). Tax, customs, social-security and FX rules are stabilised for 30 years (Arts. 75–84). Provinces and municipalities may not impose new local taxes, and gross-income tax is capped at 0.5%, conditional on their adhesion (Arts. 2, 113). Sanctions include warnings, fines and cessation of benefits (Arts. 92–100). Disputes may go to international arbitration (Arts. 109–111). Two minority reports recommend rejection.

notes: Annotated text: the bill (Proyecto de Ley, Expte. 5-P.E.-2026, mensaje 181/26 of 22 May 2026) as reported by the majority committees in Orden del Día 149 (Dictamen de mayoría), Arts. 1-117; the registry status is pending. The two minority dictámenes (II and III) are opinions and are not coded as provisions; their figures, comparisons and article references are not verified against the bill. Points a reader should know: the majority report names the regime 'Nuevas Industrias' while the minority II report refers to 'Grandes Inversiones Estratégicas'; minority reports cite article numbers that do not match the bill numbering in several places; art. 64 is syntactically incomplete as printed (the BCRA power clause), recorded as written. The 'Término del artículo 113: 30 de junio de 2026' in the header is a parliamentary deadline, not coded here. No LEI or ticker is verified; affiliated VPUs and project-specific identities are not named in the text.
